question: What affliction is Mandākinī, adored by the gods, asked to remove?
premises: Mandākinī is adored by the gods
The prayer asks her to remove something from us
The object to be removed is dullness
inference: Mandākinī is prayed to remove our dullness.
plain_english: May that Mandākinī, adored by the gods, remove our dullness.
